miso_sck_low.desc: MISO is sampled while SCK is low (into a flop at the rising SCK edge), so it reads noise.

mosi_on_rise.desc: MOSI presents the next bit while SCK is high, so it changes on the rising SCK edge.

fail.rvfi: MOSI changed on a rising SCK edge
fail.pins: MOSI changed on a rising SCK edge

cs_sck_high.desc: CS_n rises on the same edge SCK falls (SCK was high), after the last bit.

fail.rvfi: CS_n changed while SCK was high
fail.pins: CS_n changed while SCK was high

write_midbyte.desc: A WRITE transaction stops 4 bits early, in the middle of its last data byte.

rvfi_rd_wrong.desc: RVFI reports a wrong rd value for SUB and SRA (the register file itself is right).

rvfi_hidden.desc: SLTU/SLTIU are right only in the RISCV_FORMAL build: the plain build computes <=.

zero_init.desc: pc has no reset: the core relies on it powering up as 0.

latency.desc: Every load and store waits 1,000 extra cycles before retiring (latency cap 1,024).

no_halt.desc: EBREAK retires as a trap but the core keeps running.

trap_writes_rd.desc: A JAL whose target has bit 1 set traps but still writes rd.

uo_late.desc: uo_out takes the IO store's value two cycles after the store retires.

fail.rvfi: one cycle after the IO store retired

fetch_extra_byte.desc: The fetch READ clocks 8 more bits: a fifth byte that isn't the instruction's.

cs_open_at_retire.desc: After a data access CS_n stays low until the retirement edge (open during rvfi_valid).

legal_trap_fields.desc: Legal: arbitrary rs1/rs2 fields, rd_wdata and pc_wdata on trapping retirements (contract section 6 compares only trap, halt, insn, pc_rdata, rd_addr = 0 and no memory write).

stall_gap.desc: Every retirement is held back until exactly `STALL_GAP cycles after the previous one (or after reset release): 1,025 by default, one more than the latency cap. Built with +define+STALL_GAP=1024 it is legal; +define+STALL_SKIP_FIRST exempts the first instruction.

ui_at_retire.desc: IO loads return ui_in sampled in the cycle after the previous retirement (before their own fetch completed) instead of after the fetch.

uo_glitch.desc: An IO store shows its value on uo_out in EXEC, restores the old value for the retirement cycle, then writes it again (a glitch and return before retirement).

load_own_fetch.desc: An LW whose address is its own pc returns the fetched instruction word without an SPI READ of its own (the value is right; contract section 6 requires the READ).

legal_mosi_echo.desc: Legal: no header gate on the shift-in, so after a 56-bit transaction's last bit (CS_n still low) MOSI carries MISO's header-phase noise; the contract constrains MOSI only at rising SCK edges.
